title: 6/05 laptop loss destroyed the only copy of pooled_bins_run: the shipped reach-57 policy can no longer be re-solved
missing_evidence: a contemporaneous (by 2026-06-07) record of the 2026-06-05 laptop failure and of pooled_bins_run's only location — the repo's earliest mention of the laptop loss is docs/audit/2026-07-09-gpt56-sol-audit.md F5 and of the profiles' loss docs/audit/2026-09-03-emax-tail-policy.md; the memory note project_macbook_loss_2026_06_05.md is outside the repo (Route X pointer, stays reported)

a machine listing showing no pooled_bins_run copy in any preserved location (box data/hetzner_results, the R2 bucket, restic archive snapshots — names only) — Phase 2 B2; the 9/22 W0 memo reports the box held only audit_full_48seed_v2 (reported)
tier_reason: loss of recoverability: the deployed reach-57 policy's derivation inputs are gone, so mdp_policy.npz (sha 66d15471…) can be preserved and extended but never re-solved (per later operator documents); no delivery/entry/state impact and no residual reaches production

contract.text: The inputs the deployed decision policy was solved from are preserved off their working host, so the policy can be re-solved or rebuilt (a preservation/restore dependency of the deployed service).
contract.source: incident-register design §2 scope ('preservation/restore dependencies … on any host') and plan W0.1 (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-14-season-wrap-plan.md) — both written after the loss; no written contract existed on 2026-06-05

mechanism.text: the shipped pooled reach-57 policy (e1ebde9, 2026-04-15) is rebuilt from the 24-seed profiles under data/hetzner_results/pooled_bins_run, which the research launcher retrieved to the operator's local machine; no copy was on the production box and none survived elsewhere, so the 2026-06-05 laptop failure destroyed the only copy

mitigated.action: W0.1: the remaining re-solve basis (mdp_estpa_run, until then on the operator's Mac only) was copied into the box's restic archive set and its sha256 manifest matched on Mac, box and a restore into an empty directory; earlier, the 9/03 tail policy was stitched onto the unre-solvable base instead of regenerating the table

residual.text: mdp_policy.npz (sha 66d15471…) cannot be re-solved, only extended; re-solving from the estimated-PA profiles gives different boundaries, so any base-policy change is a new policy rather than a rebuild

Research profile runs are retrieved to the operator machine (scripts/baseline_profiles_hetzner.py, unchanged since e1ebde9); off-host preservation depends on a manual copy into the box's restic archive set (W0.1 did it once, for mdp_estpa_run); whether other laptop-only runs exist is unknown

watchdog.trigger: a profile set that a shipped or tail policy was solved from (named by sha in the policy's manifest) has no copy in a verified off-host backup set within a day of the policy shipping
watchdog.recovery_assertion: a restore into an empty directory reproduces the profile set's sha256 manifest and the pinned re-solve or diagnostic output (the W0.1 / W0.1b pattern)

evidence.what: the base policy's source profiles pooled_bins_run 'are lost with the old laptop and it cannot be re-solved, which is why the tail is stitched onto it rather than the whole table regenerated'
the shipped policy's own profiles (data/hetzner_results/pooled_bins_run, 24 seeds) are lost — died with the 6/05 MacBook, not on the box — so mdp_policy.npz cannot be re-solved, only extended
earliest repo mention of the laptop loss ('post-MacBook-loss backup posture')
the shipped policy's own training profiles were lost with the 2026-06-05 MacBook; the estimated-PA run is 'the only valid re-solve basis left'

evidence.locator: docs/audit/2026-09-22-w0-preservation.md §W0.1 (commit 34c0f4d; artifacts on the box — not read)
evidence.what: before 9/22 mdp_estpa_run existed on the operator's Mac only and the box's data/hetzner_results held only audit_full_48seed_v2; after the 9/22 copy all 146 files matched the manifest on the box and in a restic restore into an empty directory

evidence.locator: scripts/baseline_profiles_hetzner.py and scripts/rebuild_mdp_policy_pooled.py at e1ebde9; commit e1ebde9 message (ships the pooled policy as data/models/mdp_policy.npz)
evidence.what: the pooled policy's rebuild inputs are data/hetzner_results/pooled_bins_run/*/simulation_seed*, which the launcher retrieves to the local machine

notes: scope: IN — design §2 covers preservation/restore dependencies 'on any host' and plan W0.1 treats this loss as a preservation failure; counter-argument for EX: the service's own run/restore never depended on these files (mdp_policy.npz is tracked in git and was never lost) — the loss removed the ability to re-solve the policy, not to run or restore the service

disposition: every repo account is ≥ 34 days after 6/05 (7/09 first mention of the laptop, 9/03 first mention of the profiles), so none is contemporaneous; if the lead accepts later operator documents for a permanent-loss state, observed_incident (tier A)
not a code defect: the mechanism cites the research scripts that define the dependency; there is no fix commit and no defective deployed ref
operator_awareness: the laptop loss is on record by 2026-07-09 (ev3), the profiles' loss by 2026-09-03 (ev1); first_detectable unknown
fixtures: filled from Task 5/6 acceptance objects at build time; no test reproduces a data loss
